info.title: VerifyPaymentNotice API
info.description: API to verify the status of a payment notice in the PagoPA system

post.description: Gets Payment Notice Data. A Payment Notice is identified by its QR-CODE data.

text/xml.example: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <Envelope xmlns="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/"> <Body> <verifyPaymentNoticeReq xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns="http://pagopa-api.pagopa.gov.it/node/nodeForPsp.xsd"> <idPSP xmlns="">idPSP1</idPSP> <idBrokerPSP xmlns="">idBrokerPSP1</idBrokerPSP> <idChannel xmlns="">idChannel1</idChannel> <qrCode xmlns=""> <fiscalCode>fiscalCode1</fiscalCode> <noticeNumber>noticeNumber1</noticeNumber> </qrCode> </verifyPaymentNoticeReq> </Body> </Envelope>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <Envelope xmlns="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/"> <Body> <verifyPaymentNoticeRes xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns="http://pagopa-api.pagopa.gov.it/node/nodeForPsp.xsd"> <outcome xmlns="">OK</outcome> <fault xmlns=""> <faultCode>faultCode1</faultCode> <faultString>faultString1</faultString> <id>id1</id> <description>description1</description> <serial>1</serial> <originalFaultCode>originalFaultCode1</originalFaultCode> <originalFaultString>originalFaultString1</originalFaultString> <originalDescription>originalDescription1</originalDescription> </fault> <paymentList xmlns=""> <paymentOptionDescription> <amount>1</amount> <options>EQ</options> <dueDate>1900-01-01</dueDate> <paymentNote>paymentNote1</paymentNote> </paymentOptionDescription> <paymentOptionDescription> <amount>-79228162514264337593543950335</amount> <options>LS</options> <dueDate>0001-01-01</dueDate> <paymentNote>paymentNote2</paymentNote> </paymentOptionDescription> <paymentOptionDescription> <amount>999999999.99</amount> <options>GT</options> <dueDate>9999-12-31</dueDate> <paymentNote>paymentNote3</paymentNote> </paymentOptionDescription> <paymentOptionDescription> <amount>0.9</amount> <options>ANY</options> <dueDate>1899-11-30</dueDate> <paymentNote>paymentNote4</paymentNote> </paymentOptionDescription> <paymentOptionDescription> <amount>1.1</amount> <options>EQ</options> <dueDate>1900-02-02</dueDate> <paymentNote>paymentNote5</paymentNote> </paymentOptionDescription> </paymentList> <paymentDescription xmlns="">paymentDescription1</paymentDescription> <fiscalCodePA xmlns="">fiscalCode1</fiscalCodePA> <companyName xmlns="">companyName1</companyName> <officeName xmlns="">officeName1</officeName> </verifyPaymentNoticeRes> </Body> </Envelope>
